description: AICTIONBOT™ supplier scorecard by KULIC Advisory, built on the Execution Toolkit template T13 (supplier performance evaluation). Takes one row per supplier and period with on-time delivery (percent), defect rate (percent) or ppm, complaints (count, with deliveries per period for a rate), price change (percent) and cooperation (1 to 5), and returns per supplier points out of 100, a class (A from 85, B from 70, C from 50, D below), the trend against the previous period, the figures below target and three concrete measures for the weakest figures. Targets: on-time at least 95 %, defects at most 1 %, at most 1 complaint per 100 deliveries, price change at most 3 %, cooperation at least 4. The last row per supplier is the current period. German or English column names are recognised (Lieferant, Zeitraum, Liefertreue, Fehlerquote, Reklamationen, Lieferungen, Preisänderung, Zusammenarbeit). Deterministic, no AI, nothing stored. Needs sign-in: runs with an AICTIONBOT™ Werkbank licence; without a licence one check per connection every 30 days is free (sign in with “Connect without a licence”).

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

rows.description: Rows: supplier, period, on_time (percent), quality (defect percent) or ppm, complaints, deliveries, price_change (percent), service (1 to 5). Oldest period first.

weights.description: Optional weights: on_time, quality, complaints, price, service. Default 35, 30, 15, 10, 10.

name: rate_supplier
title: Rate suppliers with a scorecard: points and class A to D, trend against the previous period, figures below target, three measures for the supplier meeting
